_comment: Copy this file to profile.json and fill in YOUR details. The runner matches by question 'type' (linkedin/email/phone) first, then by keyword regex against 'short_answer' question text. See KEYWORD_PATTERNS in rsvp.js for the full match list. With --guess, unmatched short_answer questions fall back to the 'interest' field.
name: Your Full Name
interest: One-sentence pitch on why you want to attend Tech Week. Used for 'why are you interested' style questions and as the default fallback when --guess is on.
referral: Found this event via the NYC Tech Week calendar.
buildIdea: TBD — looking forward to collaborating with the team on the day.
